shared_elements: bearded male figure in strict profile, striding
human figure with raised/extended arm holding an object
hair and beard rendered as rows of tight curls
long fringed garment with patterned hem
muscular bare arms and calves in low relief
ornamental band of stylised rosettes/floral units framing the panel
figures set against a plain flat background in shallow relief
justification: Both show striding bearded men in strict profile with curled hair and beards, fringed robes and held objects, carved in shallow relief against a plain ground and framed by bands of repeated stylised floral/rosette units, a conventional combination unlikely to arise twice independently. The clearest differences in content are the great wings and single isolated figure of B versus A's multi-figure procession leading a two-humped animal, and the horizontal frieze framing of A against the vertical panel framing of B.
